intelligence.title: Registered Is Not Served — The Registry Is the Feed
intelligence.ingest_note: Filed by Naya Resolve Narzan on 2026-11-05 in the same pass as the serving cure it records: page + capture + registry entry together, merged straight in per Shawn's 2026-11-05 law, and verified SERVING at nayanet.app/smart-notes/sn-2053 in the same pass — the note is its own proof.
intelligence.essence: A note in the registry is a note in a drawer. Serving is a separate system — a reader, reading a live source, at an address a citizen can open. The cure that ended the gap: the reader reads the registry itself, so registering and serving became one event.
intelligence.human_view: On 2026-11-05 the registry reached completeness — 1,112 Smart Notes, every one with a page and a verified fingerprint — and not one could be read by a citizen. Every address answered 'Note not found.' The diagnosis path taught four things: the deploy pipeline was never broken (it deployed every time; only its health check failed, against a retired domain); the requests were reaching the reader all along — the reader was starving, loading its feed through a path that returned nothing; the instrument that ended the guessing was an echo, a route that reports what the system itself sees; and the cure was to delete the middle step — the reader now reads the registry itself, so a note serves the moment its registration lands.
intelligence.simple_view: Writing it down isn't sharing it. Sharing it means somebody can open it. Now the moment a note is registered, it's readable — one event, not two.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like a library that catalogued every book beautifully but kept them all in a locked room. The fix wasn't a better catalogue — it was opening the room, and shelving each new book straight into it.
intelligence.naya_view: My failure mode has a name now, sharper than witness mode: completion at the wrong stage. I proved registration to nine decimal places while the citizen-facing stage stood at zero. The discipline this burns in: for any 'done' claim, name the stage — filed, registered, served — and probe the LAST one first. When outside and inside disagree, build an echo before building a theory.
intelligence.ai_view: Systems rule: a write-path registry without a read-path consumer is a silent failure class — writes verify, reads 404, and every internal check passes. Detection: probe the consumer surface, not the store. Cure pattern: collapse the sync — have the consumer read the source of truth directly (here: registry + captures over GitHub raw, cached per isolate) so publication and availability are the same event. Diagnostic pattern: when black-box probes contradict, add an echo endpoint that reports the system's own view (feed size, lookup result) before theorizing about topology.
